name: Buat Tabel timed_count
func:
msg.topic = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS timed_count (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    timestamp  TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_s REAL NOT NULL,
    pulses     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cpm        REAL NOT NULL,
    usv_h      REAL NOT NULL,
    usv_total  REAL NOT NULL,
    lat        REAL DEFAULT 0,
    lon        REAL DEFAULT 0,
    alt_m      REAL DEFAULT 0,
    rssi       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    snr        REAL DEFAULT 0
);
`;
return msg;
